findings.F1: The book earned too little because it held little: its mean daily return was 0.000114 against holding's 0.00123, with a daily sd of 0.0042 against holding's 0.040, and its average position was only 0.017 of the book (median 0, max 0.54). The book was short on 35.6 % of bars and long on 35.9 %, so its average net exposure stayed near zero.
findings.F2: Nearly all of the gain came from the top distance decile, closes within about 3 % of the 364-day high: there the next-day excess return was +0.0033 and the position's daily gain was 0.00102. In deciles 0 to 8 the daily gain ranged only from -0.00015 to +0.00026, and the next-day excess showed no ordering by distance.
findings.F3: The short side lost money. Short bars earned a daily gain of -0.000048, because the coin still rose 0.00079 a day while the book was short. That was a market-rise cost of -0.000156, which only partly offset a timing gain of +0.000108. Long bars earned +0.00036.

findings.F5: Over the plan's own 30-day horizon the forecast's slope was not significant (t = 0.95, n = 526). The 30-day excess by forecast quintile was not monotonic: -0.027, -0.031, +0.080, -0.013, -0.008 from the lowest to the highest quintile.
findings.F6: The falls were large against the gain. The chained book's deepest fall was -16.7 % against a yearly return of 3.9 % (Calmar 0.23). Windows w16 to w24 held the seven deepest falls, at -12 % to -17 %.

ideas.idea: The closer a coin's daily close sits to its highest close of the past 52 weeks, the higher its return over the next 7 days. The rise is concentrated in the last stretch just below the high, so the gain grows faster the nearer the close is to that high. It is larger the stronger the coin's 30-day return.
ideas.consequence: Commit capital mainly to coins pressed against their 52-week high after a strong month, rather than spreading small longs and shorts across the whole range.
ideas.name: Gain concentrated at the high

ideas.idea: The closer a coin's daily close sits to its highest close of the past 52 weeks, the higher its return over the next 7 days, only while its 30-day return is positive. Inside that state, the higher the 30-day return, the larger the gain.
ideas.consequence: Read nearness to the high as a long signal only when the past month has risen, which also removes the short positions that paid for the market's rise.
ideas.name: Nearness with rising month
